headline: North Korea fires a ballistic missile (>700 km) after the DMZ mine dispute; Škoda recalls 1.7M cars for steering-bolt risk; OpenAI ships a GPT-6 family model guide.

stories.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile toward the East Sea
facts: South Korea and Japan: ballistic missile launched from the Wonsan area ~06:30 Sat local, flew >700 km toward the East Sea / Sea of Japan.
Seoul’s presidential NSC held an emergency meeting; military heightened monitoring and is sharing intel with the US and Japan.
Context: Friday, Kim Yo-jong rejected Seoul’s demand for an apology over North Korean mines that Seoul says wounded three South Korean soldiers in the DMZ.
stories.whyItMatters: First weekend missile shot tied to the DMZ mine spat and Kim Yo-jong’s Friday blast — another test of Seoul–Washington–Tokyo coordination.

image.alt: TV screen shows a North Korean missile launch file image during a news program in Seoul

stories.title: Škoda recalls ~1.7M vehicles over steering-bolt risk
facts: Czech VW subsidiary recalls about 1.7 million cars worldwide; KBA database cites a screw that can break and cause steering failure.
Affected models: Kodiaq, Karoq, Octavia, Superb; fix replaces the bolt with a corrosion-resistant screw.
Follows parent VW / Audi / SEAT recalls of several million vehicles on the same steering issue this week.
stories.whyItMatters: Largest Škoda tranche yet in the VW-group steering-bolt campaign — Germany is a big share of the park.

image.alt: Škoda vehicle illustration accompanying recall coverage

stories.title: OpenAI: practical guide to the GPT-6 model family
facts: Official guide (2 Oct): match workload — Astra for hardest reasoning, GPT-6.1 Sol for complex coding/research/computer use, Luna for routine extraction/classification at scale.

API tips: set reasoning effort low→max by task; use Fast/Ultrafast when latency matters; prefer Responses API tooling; lean on prompt caching (up to ~95% cheaper cached input) and compaction for long runs.
Long-running work: mid-turn steering, async tools, and (beta) multi-agent delegation on Sol; computer use when no API exists.
stories.whyItMatters: First clear public playbook for picking among GPT-6 variants and running them in production without burning cost on every token.

stories.title: US and Australia pause Brazil diplomatic ops before Sunday’s vote
facts: US embassy suspended consular services from Friday, citing security concerns; advised Americans not to visit embassy/consulates.
Australia’s embassy in Brasília also closed Friday, citing the US alert; ambassador advised citizens to avoid US facilities.

Brazil police ran preventive searches in São Paulo and Brasília over suspected plans against US facilities — said no corroborating threat yet; Lula vs Flávio Bolsonaro vote Sunday (runoff Oct 25 if needed).
stories.whyItMatters: Unusual pre-election diplomatic freeze lands in a race already charged with interference claims — optics matter even if police later downplay the tip.
